selection_policy: Keep a method only if it changes a decision, search, filtering, ranking, or reasoning-quality step.
Require complete primary-paper text and validated source-line citations.
Keep distinct mechanisms separate even when they address the same retrosynthesis task.
Exclude data cleaning, token alignment, model installation, training-only configuration, and human-only evaluation procedures from this five-skill set.

skills.name: reaction-center-guided-retrosynthesis
skills.paper: Retroformer: Pushing the Limits of End-to-end Retrosynthesis Transformer
skills.capability: Select connected reaction-center hypotheses, prune overlapping centers, and condition ranked reactant generation on the retained centers.
skills.why_selected: Adds an explicit reaction-site decision before precursor generation and provides positive thresholds, pruning, diversity, and ranking rules.

skills.name: retro-star-retrosynthetic-planning
skills.paper: Retro*: Learning Retrosynthetic Planning with Neural Guided A* Search
skills.capability: Use an AND-OR tree and estimated complete-route cost to decide which frontier molecule to expand and when to stop.
skills.why_selected: Changes route-level search from local reaction ranking to cost-aware best-first planning with explicit first-solution and optimality stopping conditions.

skills.name: experience-guided-retrosynthetic-search
skills.paper: Retrosynthetic planning with experience-guided Monte Carlo tree search
skills.capability: Propagate success and failure through an AND-OR tree and use experience-guided scores during budgeted route search.
skills.why_selected: Provides a complementary search policy that learns from prior successful and failed decomposition actions rather than relying only on admissible cost estimates.

skills.name: generate-and-filter-chemical-reasoning-examples
skills.paper: Reasoning-Driven Retrosynthesis Prediction with Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
skills.capability: Generate task-specific chemical rationales, summarize them, score chemical correctness and logic, and retain only high-quality examples.
skills.why_selected: Introduces an explicit Analyzer-Summarizer-Assessor loop that can improve the chemical reasoning demonstrations supplied to an agent.

skills.name: augment-and-rank-retrosynthesis-predictions
skills.paper: Reasoning-Driven Retrosynthesis Prediction with Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
skills.capability: Increase precursor diversity through product-SMILES and reasoning-trajectory sampling, then canonicalize, filter, merge, and frequency-rank candidates.
skills.why_selected: Changes the answer-selection path when ordinary beam search collapses to duplicate precursors and includes concrete validity and aggregation rules.

deduplication.rationale: The five skills operate at different decision layers: reaction-site selection, cost-guided route search, experience-guided route search, reasoning-example quality control, and final candidate diversification/ranking. Retro* and EG-MCTS share an AND-OR representation but use different selection and update mechanisms, so they are related variants rather than duplicates.
